description.value: COBS Bread Terminal Park Bakery is a franchise location of the Canadian bakery chain that bakes all products from scratch on-site daily, with no refrigeration or freezing of goods. The Nanaimo outlet offers a broad range of breads, buns, rolls, bagels, scones, croissants, and savoury items including pizza-style products. Unsold baked goods are donated to local charities at day's end, a hallmark of the chain's community commitment.
